voxel_state_animation.note: Whole-cell flow colors and top plume occupancy remain visibly animated at 10Hz. Impact droplets move on quantized ballistic arcs using a fixed MultiMesh pool; no per-frame Node, Resource, Array or Dictionary creation, mesh rebuild or gameplay collider mutation.

splash.note: Each impact owns six pooled droplets with staggered deterministic ballistic arcs. Lifetimes end at the receiving water. No random runtime emission or collision processing.

animation_support.status: Source clips, flow, plume and 48-droplet pool data retained. The static common compiler does not replay them. No claim of replacing the legacy animated preview.

structural_fidelity.policy: Structure must explain function at every supported quality. Openings, supports, fluid origins and contacts are authored in the master, not painted on afterward.
structural_fidelity.lod_policy: Sample source independently. Preserve at least two cells across an open channel and one cell for its rail, floor and water depth. Simplify coarse outlets while retaining the path; never fill a functional opening.

migration.clearance_change: Outlet masonry cuts extend to the authored visual envelope y=3.6; source radial range and channel width are retained. No masonry exists above the original clearance in those radial ranges.
migration.known_gap: Dynamic playback is still unsupported by the static common compiler. Structural and render checks must be run for each requested pitch.

changes_from_source.change: All three source surfaces and their adjoining layers use shared nearest-grid planes and at-least-one-cell depths.
changes_from_source.reason: Independent thickness expansion erased the lower outlet floors at pitch 0.1 and in a two-layer generic fixture.

changes_from_source.change: Falling jet tubes explicitly use minimum_radius_cells=1 instead of 0.75. Source continuous radius and 64-segment curve points are unchanged.
changes_from_source.reason: Both the original width-48 sample and common center sampling had six-neighbor gaps; this is an authored feature-preservation change, not a silent compiler change.
changes_from_source.visual_effect: The sampled jets can become thicker. Numeric connected checks and actual matched renders are required; no universal mathematical guarantee is claimed.

provenance.scope: Entire revision-2 source geometry lowered to the common shape vocabulary, with all legacy animation and connection metadata retained. Authoring-only migration; normal compilation reads this JSON without importing an asset generator.
